purpose: Pins the comparison target to an immutable commit. An earlier revision told Role B to read the target 'as registered on main', which let the target drift after preregistration.
access_rule: Role B reads every target file at commit 3ba4986b86b6e211d9e01e78018ef8324297f86c, e.g. `git show 3ba4986b86b6e211d9e01e78018ef8324297f86c:<path>`. Reading the working tree or current main is a protocol violation.
drift_rule: If any target file changes after this pin, the executor must EITHER execute against the pinned commit as recorded here, OR register a new protocol version with a new pin. Silent remapping against current main is prohibited.
verification: Role B records the sha256 of each file as read and confirms it matches this pin before mapping.
